summary: Master the principles of data mining with our specialized training course. Develop the expertise to extract valuable information from complex datasets.
lede: Data mining principles help analysts and business intelligence professionals find patterns in datasets and build predictive models. It supports professionals moving beyond basic reporting as they acquire, clean, and prepare data, explore patterns, and choose classification or clustering methods for business questions. Training also covers model validation, association-rule analysis, visualizing results, and communicating findings to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals who need to move from basic data reporting to advanced predictive analytics and pattern discovery.
modules: Association Rule Mining and Market Basket Analysis
Text Mining and Natural Language Processing
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of basic statistics (mean, median, standard deviation) and experience working with data in spreadsheets or databases. Familiarity with basic SQL queries is recommended but not required, as core technical concepts will be covered during the training.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
